description:
• About our brand and products:

We create handcrafted wooden animal automata that combine traditional craftsmanship with gentle mechanical motion. Each piece is carefully carved from natural wood and designed to move smoothly by hand, bringing a sense of calm, curiosity, and timeless beauty into everyday spaces.

Our products are not toys or mass-produced décor — they are meaningful objects meant to be watched, felt, and appreciated.


• What makes us different:

  • Handcrafted, not factory-made

  • Real mechanical movement, no batteries or screens

  • Inspired by nature, animals, and slow living

  • Designed to be calming, collectible, and gift-worthy

  • Visually captivating and highly shareable in short-form content

We focus on emotion, story, and experience — not trends or fast consumption.


• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commissions for every successful sale generated through their unique affiliate links or content.

You earn by:

  • Sharing our products in your content

  • Introducing our brand to an audience that values design and craftsmanship

  • Creating authentic, story-driven recommendations

The more your audience resonates with our creations, the more you earn — naturally and sustainably.


• How to promote us:

You’re free to promote us in ways that feel most natural to you, including:

  • Short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

  • Product showcases and calming visual loops

  • Storytelling, unboxing, or gift ideas

  • Lifestyle, home décor, or creative content

We encourage authenticity over hard selling. Let the movement, detail, and feeling speak for themselves.


• Other information:

  • Open to creators worldwide

  • No follower minimum — quality and creativity matter more than size

  • We value long-term partnerships over one-off promotions

  • Brand assets and support are available when needed

If you love meaningful objects and enjoy sharing things that make people slow down and feel something — you’ll fit right in.
payout_period: Affiliate payments are processed on the 15th of each month.
